real_objective: Make Brain genuinely own Opus-5.5-or-better capabilities rather than merely route to external models/services that already possess them.
governing_invariants: Capabilities must be internalized into Brain-owned operative configurations and saved permanently.
External models/services can be capability specimens and general computation substrates, but their hidden target behavior cannot itself receive Brain ownership credit.
Brain-configured route itself must verify >= Opus 5.5.
material_premises: The three newly promoted Opus packages identified GPT-6 Astra itself as the operative model/supplier and did not contain a distinct Brain-owned capability mechanism responsible for the target behavior.
Their benchmark evidence therefore proved that equal-or-better capability specimens exist, not that Brain had internalized those capabilities.
The V5 model-provider law was permissive enough to allow an opaque frontier model's hidden behavior to be mislabeled as a Brain-owned configured capability.
Exact symbolic computation is materially different because the operative mechanism is represented in Brain-owned executable configuration using SymPy, with independent verification.
conclusion: Revoke all three opaque-model ownership credits, preserve their benchmark wins only as specimen evidence, tighten capability ownership to require Brain-owned operative configuration, and reopen the full capability-internalization frontier.

rejected_material_alternatives.reason: Saved routing preserves access, not the capability itself.
Too strong and inconsistent with the theory; models may supply general computation/cognition substrate.
Would leave false capability credit in canonical state.

uncertainties: For some frontier capabilities, the reusable mechanism may be available only as skills/scaffolds/procedures around a general model rather than as deterministic software.
Some opaque external capability specimens may not expose an internalizable already-existing mechanism under the hard constraints, which would create theory-falsification candidates.
assumptions: The user's distinction between knowledge, general computation, and capability configuration is authoritative.

Brain-owned prompts/skills/procedures/workflows/software can constitute capability configurations when they materially produce the capability and the Brain-configured route itself verifies at target strength.
non_goals: Do not reverse to model-independence as a goal.
Do not invent missing underlying capabilities.
Do not discard external benchmark evidence; retain it as specimen evidence.
next_action: For each Opus 5.5 capability, use benchmark-winning systems only as specimens, find an already-existing reusable mechanism/configuration, internalize that into Brain, and verify the Brain-configured route itself.
supersession_conditions: Explicit user correction of the capability-ownership definition.
Evidence that the theory requires a different boundary between general computation substrate and operative capability configuration.
supersedes: Any V5 interpretation that counts durable routing to an opaque model/service as capability ownership.
The three September 30 ownership promotions based solely on GPT-6 Astra benchmark superiority.
